items.html: *Know that the ten Sefirot are five complete Partzufim: Arich Anpin, which is Keter and has ten Sefirot in it; and likewise Aba and Ima are complete Partzufim, and there are ten Sefirot in each one of them; and likewise ZON, each one is included of ten. But know that the Tifferet, when it was emanated, was only an existence of six, and was called VAK, from Chesed to Yesod, and it had no head. And this is the secret of the Vav within the Hei, in Bina, which has no head.
